sentence_stem: The writer had never published a story before,
correct_completion: so she was nervous about the reaction of readers.
full_sentence: The writer had never published a story before, so she was nervous about the reaction of readers.
acceptable_variants: so she felt anxious about what critics would say.
so the publication day made her very worried.

options.text: so she was nervous about the reaction of readers.
but she had already won a prize.
options.why_wrong: The contrast here is not supported by the stem, which gives a reason for nervousness.

options.text: although she had written many novels.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which says she had never published a story before.

options.text: because the story was very short.
options.why_wrong: The length of the story does not explain why she is nervous about readers.

explanation: The word so introduces a result that follows from the first part of the sentence. The completion must show the writer's feeling as a consequence of her inexperience.
translation: La escritora nunca había publicado una historia antes, así que estaba nerviosa por la reacción de los lectores.
